features.name: Runnable foundation and internal identity sessions
features.description: Reuse audited N1 Argon2/session primitives and N2 migration runner; implement the seven ACs in docs/features/foundation before mounting public enrollment/auth routes.

features.name: Identity, program policy and partner consent
features.description: Implement trusted enrollment, hash-only sessions, owner/partner scopes, versioned program policy, terms acceptance and personal partner assets.

features.name: N1 attribution and authenticated bridge
features.description: Capture link/cookie/promo attribution, reject self-referral, and deliver versioned authenticated N1 registration/payment/refund facts through an atomic outbox and reconciliation cursor.

features.name: Verified payment and commission ledger
features.description: Post at most one positive commission for each eligible verified N1 payment using the attribution policy snapshot and append-only provenance.

features.name: Refund corrections and recovery
features.description: Apply partial/full refund deltas once, tolerate reorder and replay, reconcile gaps, and preserve restore reservations and observations without rewriting history.

features.name: Monthly registry and tax preparation
features.description: Freeze the prior calendar month, carry negative balances once, keep unknown legal/tax/YTD inputs blocked, and prepare an auditable payout without sending money.

features.name: Authorized manual transfer record
features.description: Record owner/operator transfer evidence and actual date against the immutable due date; export remains state-free and sent does not assert bank receipt.

features.name: Owner and partner CJM A views
features.description: Show scoped clicks, registrations, confirmed customers, ledger provenance, corrections, payable state and literal MRR unknown with accessible CJM A presentation.

features.name: N1 value-moment share and public badge
features.description: Offer an intentional share only after the first real confirmed commission and enforce the separate server-side free-page badge rule without changing N1 testimonial widgets.

features.name: D7 N3a platform affiliate proposal
features.description: Owner must choose lead-only pilot or specify N3a price, billing authority and verified-payment contract for monetary dogfooding. N1 sales cannot substitute for N3a sales.
